body:
Based on a conversation from https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/2585,  I think a small change to 11.1.9 would be useful. 

I suggest we move from:

_11.1.9 [ADDED] Verify that atomic transactions are implemented at the business logic level to ensure that a business operation either completes fully or fails entirely, reverting the system to a consistent, correct state if an error occurs._

: to :

_11.1.9 [ADDED] Verify that transactions are implemented at the business logic level to ensure that a business operation either completes fully or fails entirely, reverting the system to a consistent, correct state if an error occurs._

And drop the "atomic" term. I think dropping the "atomic" still makes this requirement meaningful and more clear. What do you think?

comments.body: I am comfortable with that, @jmanico will you open a PR?
